content: Yazdī collection item 8, in reply to Ibn Turka (ca. 817/1415, Shiraz or Yazd?), found only in MS Sinā 316: Yazdī congratulates Ibn Turka on completing his commentary on the Fuṣūṣ al-Ḥikam and says he will accompany him on a trip to Khurasan including a pilgrimage to the shrine of Imam ʿAlī al-Riḍā at Mashhad (YMN/MS pp. 257-58). MK's footnote: the Sharḥ Fuṣūṣ was completed in 814/1411 with a corrected version in 817/1415 in Fars.
